answers.WHAT_IS_GRUT: A declared mathematical/structural framework plus an effective open-system (transport/response) description built on declared but under-specified construction choices. Its strongest surviving pieces are self-consistency diagnostics (Ward/gauge-orbit zero of K_R, mu=4/3 normalization arithmetic, TT projector structure), not closed dynamics.
answers.WHAT_IS_IT_NOT: Not a closed theory. Not a derived effective theory (inputs are stance-declared, not derived). Not yet a predictive theory: PREDICTED is empty. Not a completed open-system model (the system/bath -> free correlator -> Sigma_R fork is typed but not fully constructed).
WHAT_WORKS: Ward-sourced gauge-orbit zero of K_R (annihilation of the full 4d gauge orbit) — corpus-supported structural result
mu = 4/3 (scalar:spin-2 = 2:1) normalization arithmetic in the linearized Einstein-Hilbert response
K^R = alpha*chi(omega)*P^TT structural form with adopted c_0 = alpha DC normalization (an ADOPTION, not a derivation)
reduced-basis / deterministic pipeline mechanics and reproducible provenance infrastructure
WHAT_FAILS: constitutive/linear dynamics route to quantum outcome selection

answers.CLOSED_OR_OPEN: OPEN — and the openings are exactly the seven declared construction choices; the corpus itself does not close them.
answers.STRONGEST_HONEST_DESCRIPTION: A self-consistent, provenance-disciplined mathematical framework whose dynamical content is an open-system effective description resting on seven declared construction choices that its own corpus cannot type stably; its positive results are consistency diagnostics and adoptions, and it currently makes no genuine prediction distinguishing it from GR/SM/EFT.

final_question: What survives when we force all of GRUT to become one actual physical model?
final_answer: The provenance discipline, the negative results, and a small set of consistency diagnostics survive. No closed dynamics, no genuine prediction, and seven unresolved inputs survive with it. That is the program, as it stands.
